NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 376 Posts - Complete Details

National Informatics Centre (NIC) has released the Recruitment 2026 notification for Scientific/Technical Assistant posts. A total of 376 vacancies have been announced under this recruitment drive. The online application process will be conducted from 01 September 2026 to 30 September 2026. Interested candidates can apply online through the official website, nic.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Application Last Date : 30.09.2026 (05:30 PM)
  • Opening Date for Online Applications : 01.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Closing Date for Online Applications : 30.09.2026 (05:30 PM)
  • Cut-off Date for Eligibility : 30.09.2026 (same as closing date)
  • Service Candidate : UR/EWS: 35 years; SC/ST: 40 years; OBC(NCL): 38 years
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates : Nil

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Scientific/Technical Assistant-A
  • Post Type : Group-B S&T (Non-Gazetted)
  • Application Start Date : 01.09.2026 (10:00 AM)
  • Application Last Date : 30.09.2026 (05:30 PM)
  • Document Verification Schedule : Will be announced on NIC website, www.recruitment.nic.in
  • Discipline : GATE Paper Code
  • Computer Sciences and Information Technology : CS
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence : DA
  • SC / ST : 35 years
  • OBC (NCL) : 33 years
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates : Nil
  • UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS : ₹800

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
